scope: Telnyx regional TLS identities for SIP in-dialog fallback

baseline.error: x509: certificate is valid for sip.telnyx.eu, not sip.telnyx.com

invariants: Standard TLS certificate chain, validity, server usage and hostname verification enabled
Explicit Telnyx identity allowlist: sip.telnyx.com, sip.telnyx.eu
At most one retry after matching hostname failure, under existing request context
Dialog destination and carrier source-network restrictions preserved
Custom and other-provider identities remain exact
No audio framing, pacing or stale-audio policy changes

linux_build.command: GOWORK=off GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -o /tmp/telephony-regional-tls-linux .
